mentions.name: Agent Witness
mentions.description: A PWA that acts as a remote ssh-agent. Private keys are wrapped, encrypted, and stored in IndexedDB locally on the phone; the vault can only be unwrapped with a secret derived from a passkey, and all key handling and signing happens locally through the browser's Web Crypto APIs as non-extractable CryptoKey objects. Incoming signing requests arrive as push notifications showing the reason supplied, the command being run, and the key requested; after passkey authorization only the resulting signature goes back to the server, so the private key never leaves the phone.
mentions.problem: Handling private key signing for headless agents remotely without exposing private keys, keeping them on the phone instead of the server.
